title: fix(plugin-list): on a phone the list toolbar keeps the view name readable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9E6p35JApCcNeQoT3UszPeh)_

Fixes #33833

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机宽度（640px 以下）下，列表工具条在视图名后面放不下筛选芯片、「在队列中」和工具图标时会自动换行，视图名保留整行宽度；工具图标留在右侧。桌面宽度不变。
- 为什么改：375px 下工具条把视图名挤成一个字（「全部客户」显示为「全.」），手机用户分不清当前是哪个视图。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `plugin-list` 工具条的 `max-sm:` 样式，且仅在宿主传入 `toolbarLeading`（Console 在手机宽度传入视图切换器）时生效；手机上工具条可能多占一行。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/listToolbarRow.ts`（全部样式常量），`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（工具条五处 className），`ui/e2e/list-toolbar-view-name-phone.spec.ts`（几何断言）。
- 两分钟验证：手机宽度（375px）打开 showcase 的 Projects 列表，「All Projects」完整显示，Status / Health 芯片同行，筛选 / 显示 / 搜索图标在第二行右侧；桌面宽度与原来一样。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/listToolbarRow.ts` (new): the toolbar row's layout classes as named string constants, with the four phone additions:
  - row: `max-sm:flex-wrap max-sm:gap-x-2 max-sm:gap-y-1`;
  - left group: `max-sm:contents`, so its items (the leading node, the filter chips, the 「In a queue」 toggle) wrap in the row;
  - leading node wrapper: `max-sm:basis-auto`, so the view name is sized by its content and anything that no longer fits beside it moves to the next line;
  - filter chips: `max-sm:shrink`, so a chip row wider than the phone scrolls inside its own `overflow-x-auto` box;
  - tool cluster: `max-sm:ml-auto`, so it keeps the right edge on whichever line it lands.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: the toolbar's five class strings now come from those constants. The phone additions apply only when a host passes `toolbarLeading`; without one the rendered class strings are byte-identical to `main` (the `ListView.toolbarLeading-12440` pin still reads today's left group).
- `ui/e2e/list-toolbar-view-name-phone.spec.ts` (new): a Playwright geometry pin, see Tests.
- `.changeset/33833-list-toolbar-view-name-phone.md`: patch, `@object-ui/plugin-list`.

No app-shell or plugin-view edit: below `VIEW_TABS_MIN_WIDTH` (640) the Console hands the title switcher to the list as `toolbarLeading`, and the row that starved it is plugin-list's toolbar (claim amendment 6895939370).

## Why

At 375 px the toolbar row held the view switcher, the filter chips, the 「In a queue」 toggle and four 44 px touch-target icons on one line. Every item except the switcher was `shrink-0`, so the switcher's `truncate` label took what was left: 23.28 px of 64 px for 「全部客户」 in the probe, 20.11 px of 85 px for 「All Projects」 in the live Console.

## Tests

`ui/e2e/list-toolbar-view-name-phone.spec.ts` lays out the toolbar row in Chromium with real Tailwind compiled from the installed `tailwindcss`. The classes are read from the sources at run time: the row constants by name from `listToolbarRow.ts`, the queue toggle's and Filter button's class strings and `PHONE_TOUCH_TARGET` from plugin-list, the switcher's trigger, outer span and count from `objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`, and the phone title wrapper from `ObjectView.tsx`. A first case checks that `ListView.tsx` still reads every constant, so the spec cannot measure classes nobody draws.

- 320, 375 and 390 px, labels 「全部客户」 and 「All Customers」: the label is not clipped, nothing scrolls the page sideways, the queue toggle and the tool cluster stay in the row, and the cluster keeps the row's right edge.
- 375 px with five filter chips (wider than the row): the label is whole, the chips stay inside the row, no page overflow.
- 375 px with a 52-character name: it is truncated with an ellipsis and keeps more than 60% of the row.
- CONTROL, 1280 px: the row's geometry with the phone classes equals its geometry without them (every measured rect), the label is whole, and the queue toggle and cluster share the name's line.

Local run: `10 passed`.

<details><summary>Ablations: one per phone class, each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty</summary>

| Leg | Mutation in `listToolbarRow.ts` | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A | row without `max-sm:flex-wrap` | 8 failed, 2 passed: label 16.00 px of 64 px (320/375), 22.94 px of 64 px (390) |
| B | left group without `max-sm:contents` | 8 failed, 2 passed: label 16.00 px of 64 px; long name 16.00 px in a 375 px row |
| C | cluster `max-sm:ml-auto` → `max-sm:mr-0` | 6 failed, 4 passed: "the tool cluster left the right edge" |
| D | leading without `max-sm:basis-auto` | 7 failed, 3 passed |
| E | chips `max-sm:shrink` → `max-sm:shrink-0` | 1 failed, 9 passed: the five-chip case |

The two cases that stay green in A and B are the constants check and the 1280 px control, as they should. No build sits between mutation and run: the spec reads the source text.

</details>

<details><summary>Narrowed vitest runs</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/` under the lock: Test Files 173 passed (173), Tests 1856 passed (1856).
- Toolbar neighbours under the lock (nine `ListView.*toolbar*/phone*/queue*` pins, `ViewTabBar.hostWidth-12518`, `ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594`, `ObjectView.objectListTitle-27950`, `ObjectView.chartViewTabs-13114`): Test Files 13 passed (13), Tests 86 passed (86).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:e2e`: exit 0. eslint on the three touched source files: 0 errors (warnings are pre-existing in `ListView.tsx`).
- app-shell's full suite is left to CI `Test UI`; app-shell has no edit here.

</details>

## Verification

Real browser, the live Console (`@object-ui/console` dev server on this branch, against `examples/app-showcase` booted with `--seed-admin`), Playwright Chromium, 375×812 at deviceScaleFactor 2, then 1280×800:

| List | Width | Before (`main`'s `ListView.tsx`) | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| Projects (2 filter chips) | 375 | 「All Projects」 20.11 px of 85 px, toolbar 63 px | 85.28 px of 85 px, toolbar 111 px (two lines), page overflow 0 |
| Tasks (no chips) | 375 | 67.73 px of 68 px | 67.73 px of 68 px |
| Projects | 1280 | 92.91 px of 93 px, page header title | same |

Screenshots (project files): `ui-seat1/33833-shots/33833-before-showcase_project-375.png`, `33833-after-showcase_project-375.png`, and the task / 1280 px pairs beside them. The before leg put `main`'s `ListView.tsx` back under HMR and restored it to the HEAD blob afterwards (`git diff HEAD` empty).

Premise on `origin/main` 895783a1 in the fixture probe: 「全部客户」 23.28 px of 64 px at 375 px, 64/64 at 1280 px.

<details><summary>Gates at head e29b2d2a</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 37 families for the 4 changed paths; each ran locally and exited 0 (two under the lock: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` 171 passed, 2 skipped files; `pnpm check:type-check-debt`).
- `--ran` reconciliation: "37 derived, 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- Outside the derived list: `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` "0 new citation(s)"; `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:e2e` exit 0.
- Every other family is CI's; its check-runs on this PR are the reading.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- On a phone the toolbar can now take a second line (the Projects list: 63 px to 111 px). That is the card's chosen direction (wrap or fold); a fold into an overflow menu was not built.
- The open phone search field (`w-36`) was not measured here; it replaces the Search icon in the same cluster, so it wraps with it.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the touched files reports 0 errors (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
